description: This file configures NextAuth authentication with Azure AD provider, including user find-or-create logic, callback handling for sign-in, JWT, and session management, and exports the NextAuth handler for API routes.

methods.name: findOrCreateAzureUser
methods.description: Asynchronously finds or creates a user in the backend via a POST request, returning user data and token.
